edges: Article I, Section 2, Clause 5 of the Constitution grants the House of Representatives the sole power of impeachment.
Article I, Section 3, Clause 6 of the Constitution grants the Senate the sole power to try all impeachments.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The House is obligated to base any charges on the constitutional standards specified in Article II, Section 4.
The House of Representatives elects the Speaker of the House on the first day of every new Congress.
